title: Chart image of the non-differentiability set of f∘Φ is Hⁿ-null (Rademacher)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q locally Lipschitz on U, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P K-Lipschitz on Ω. Then Hⁿ(Φ(Z)) = 0, where Z = {w ∈ Ω : Φ(w) ∈ U and f∘Φ is not Fréchet differentiable at w} and Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (K : ℝ≥0), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (Φ '' {w | w ∈ Ω ∧ Φ w ∈ U ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w}) = 0
